prose.text: No entry is a live leg: every check boots what it reads in process, or starts and stops its own host, so there is no liveness probe and no `stop` key. No boot path is edited — the `escher-session` binary's `main`, the windowed stand's `main`, `seven_guis::stand` and the sink are untouched — so no boot smoke is listed beyond the standing hosted checks, which run the binary and read what a call answers. The project has no headful self-verify harness; the stand's two edited task files change no painted value, which the attributes-only entry holds. No dependency enters and no manifest changes, which the preservation entry holds; the audit leg is therefore not listed. **Not run locally:** the MSRV build and the windows, macos, ios and android matrix legs — the fork's CI run is their one witness, read after the operator pass; neither new check file carries a `cfg(unix)` gate, so the windows and macos jobs run them.

`evidence/controls.md` has no listed producer, by construction: it is implement's record of step 10's one-shot readings — the red readings on the engine as built, which no entry can re-produce once the tree has moved, and the mutation controls, which mutate source and revert; what it records is asserted by listed entries (the two new check files and the two extended ones, under both builds). Step 11's readings are the report's, taken from the listed entries' logs and from one hosted `snapshot` per task driven by hand.
